critical_code_review_comments: routes_report._build_rapor is called sequentially per student in rapor-class; for large classes this is O(N) round trips. Consider batching assessments/attendance/tahfidz queries by class or aggregating with $in on student_ids.

routes_cron._run_backup runs in a BackgroundTasks without a lock; concurrent /api/cron/backup + /api/backups/run-now calls could interleave. Consider a simple in-memory or Mongo-based mutex to prevent double writes / retention race.
routes_cron backup writes JSON files to /app/backups without size caps; a large DB could fill disk. Consider file size logging + alerting or a max-size guard.
whatsapp.send_bulk logs failures but the caller (recap-blast) does not persist per-message delivery status; adding a wa_send_log collection would help debug production failures.
routes_whatsapp.recap-blast returns 400 when there are 0 recipients (no parent_phone). That is fine for admin UI, but frontend Kirim WA button should surface this message clearly.
settings.whatsapp_api_key returned in GET /api/settings (admin) in plaintext -- acceptable as admin-only but consider masking (e.g. last 4 chars) when surfacing in future UI screens.
